get.summary: Get External Investment Order Manager orders.
get.description:
Get a collection of `External Investment Order Manager` orders.
The result set can be restricted through filter parameter.
Only `External Investment Order Manager` orders will be returned that can be accessed by the user (security applied).
Paging is supported with parameters *limit* and *offset*.

post.summary: Create a new External Investment Order Manager order

201.description: Successfully created a new `External Investment Order Manager` order

get.summary: Get a External Investment Order Manager order
get.description:
*Get a `External Investment Order Manager` order by ID*.
Only `External Investment Order Manager` order will be returned that can be accessed by the user (security applied).
If user does not have access to resource, not found error will be returned instead of unauthorized - to disallow attacks.

parameters.name: doc_xiom_id
parameters.description: ID of the `External Investment Order Manager` order to get

patch.summary: Modify/update an existing External Investment Order Manager order
patch.description:
*Partially modify/update an existing `External Investment Order Manager` order identified by ID*.
Only `External Investment Order Manager` order will be replaced that can be accessed by the user (security applied).
If user does not have access to resource, not found error will be returned instead of unauthorized - to disallow attacks.

parameters.name: doc_xiom_id
parameters.description: ID of the `External Investment Order Manager` order to modify/update
